Barbell bench press.what: Lie on a flat bench and press a barbell up from your chest. The main chest builder.
steps: Lie down with eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor
Grip a bit wider than shoulders, lift the bar off the rack
Lower slowly to your lower chest
Press back up until arms are straight

Barbell bent-over row.what: Lean forward holding a barbell and pull it to your stomach. Builds a thick upper back.
steps: Hold the bar, bend knees slightly, push hips back
Lean forward until your back is close to 45°, keep it flat
Pull the bar to your belly button
Lower under control

Seated dumbbell shoulder press.what: Sit on an upright bench and press two dumbbells overhead. Builds shoulders.
steps: Sit with back against the bench, dumbbells at shoulder height
Press up until arms are nearly straight
Lower back to shoulder height

Lat pulldown.what: Sit at a cable machine and pull a wide bar down to your chest. Builds the wide muscles of the back.
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad, grab the bar wide
Lean back slightly, pull the bar to your upper chest
Let it rise slowly until arms are straight

Dumbbell lateral raise.what: Lift light dumbbells out to your sides. Makes shoulders look wider.
steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides
Raise arms out sideways with a slight elbow bend
Stop at shoulder height, lower slowly
Go light; this is a small muscle

EZ-bar curl.what: Curl a zig-zag bar up to your shoulders. Builds biceps.
steps: Stand holding the bar with palms facing up
Keep elbows pinned at your sides
Curl up to shoulder height, lower slowly

Rope triceps pushdown.what: Push a rope handle down on a high cable. Builds triceps (back of the arm).
steps: Clip a rope to the top pulley, hold both ends
Elbows at your sides, push down until arms are straight
Pull the rope ends apart at the bottom, then let it rise

Barbell back squat.what: Squat down and up with a barbell across your upper back. The main leg builder.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back in a rack, step back
Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit down and back until thighs are about parallel to the floor
Stand back up, keep chest up

Romanian deadlift.what: Hinge forward with a barbell, keeping legs nearly straight. Builds hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs
Soft knees, push hips back and slide the bar down your legs
Stop when you feel a strong stretch behind your thighs
Squeeze your glutes to stand up

Bulgarian split squat.what: A one-leg squat with your back foot resting on a bench. Builds quads and glutes. Photo shows the floor version; same movement.
steps: Stand in front of a bench, put the top of one foot on it behind you
Hold dumbbells at your sides
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Push up through the front foot; do all reps, then switch legs

Lying leg curl.what: Lie face down on a machine and curl your heels to your bum. Builds hamstrings.
steps: Lie face down, pad just above your heels
Curl your heels up toward your bum
Lower slowly over 3 seconds

Standing calf raise.what: Rise up onto your toes under load. Builds calves.
steps: Stand on a step or machine with heels hanging off
Let heels drop for a full stretch
Rise as high as you can on your toes, pause 1 second

Hanging knee raise.what: Hang from a bar and lift your knees to your chest. Builds abs. Photo shows the harder straight-leg version; bend your knees.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar, arms straight
Bring knees up toward your chest, curling your hips
Lower slowly without swinging

Pull-up (weighted or assisted).what: Hang from a bar and pull your chin over it. Builds the back and biceps. Use the assisted machine or a band if you can't do 6 yet.
steps: Grab the bar a bit wider than shoulders, hang with straight arms
Pull until your chin is over the bar
Lower all the way down

Incline dumbbell press.what: Press dumbbells up on a bench tilted to about 30°. Builds the upper chest.
steps: Set the bench to a low incline and lie back
Start with dumbbells at chest level
Press up until arms are straight, lower slowly

Seated cable row.what: Sit at a low cable and pull a handle to your stomach. Builds the middle back.
steps: Sit with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeeze shoulder blades together
Let arms stretch forward without rounding your back

Cable or machine chest fly.what: Bring your arms together in front of you in a hugging motion. Builds chest.
steps: Sit at the fly machine with handles at chest height
Elbows slightly bent, bring hands together in front
Open back up slowly until you feel a chest stretch

Face pull.what: Pull a rope toward your face on a high cable. Builds rear shoulders and keeps shoulders healthy.
steps: Set a rope at head height, grab it palms down
Pull toward your forehead, elbows high and wide
Pause, then return slowly

Incline dumbbell curl.what: Curl dumbbells while lying back on an incline bench. Stretches and builds the biceps.
steps: Lie back on a bench set to about 45°, arms hanging straight
Curl both dumbbells up without moving your elbows
Lower all the way down

Overhead triceps extension.what: Extend a rope or dumbbell overhead. Builds the long part of the triceps.
steps: Face away from a cable with the rope behind your head
Elbows point forward and stay still
Straighten your arms overhead, then bend back slowly

Deadlift (conventional or trap bar).what: Lift a loaded bar from the floor to standing. Builds the whole back side of the body.
steps: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot
Hinge down and grip just outside your legs, back flat
Push the floor away and stand tall
Lower the bar the same way it came up

Leg press.what: Push a weighted platform away with your legs on a machine. Builds quads and glutes.
steps: Sit with feet shoulder-width in the middle of the platform
Release the safety and lower until knees reach about 90°
Press back up without locking your knees

Dumbbell walking lunge.what: Take long steps forward, dropping your back knee each time. Builds legs. Photo is without weights; hold dumbbells at your sides.
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides
Step forward and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Push up and step through with the other leg

Leg extension.what: Straighten your legs against a pad on a machine. Isolates the front of the thighs.
steps: Sit with the pad on your lower shins
Straighten your legs, pause 1 second at the top
Lower slowly

Seated calf raise.what: Raise your heels while seated with a pad on your knees. Builds the lower calf.
steps: Sit with the pad on your thighs, balls of feet on the step
Drop heels for a stretch
Push up onto your toes, lower slowly

Cable crunch.what: Kneel at a high cable and crunch down. Builds abs.
steps: Kneel facing the cable, hold the rope beside your head
Curl your chest down toward your knees
Hips stay still; return slowly

Goblet squat to box.what: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and squat down to a bench or box. Builds legs and glutes with an upright, back-friendly position.
steps: Stand in front of a bench, feet a bit wider than hips
Hold a dumbbell upright against your chest, elbows tucked
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench
Drive through your whole foot to stand, squeeze your glutes at the top

Dumbbell Romanian deadlift.what: Hinge forward holding two dumbbells, keeping your back flat. Builds hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees
Breathe out and gently brace your belly
Push hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs
Stop at mid-shin or when your back starts to round, then squeeze glutes to stand

Seated cable row (neutral grip).what: Pull a close, palms-facing handle to your stomach. Strengthens the upper back to support the shoulder.
steps: Use the V-handle so palms face each other
Sit tall, chest up, shoulders down away from your ears
Pull to your belly button, elbows close to your sides
Return slowly; don't let the weight pull your shoulders forward
Seated cable row (neutral grip).caution: Shoulder: build up gradually and keep it pain-free. Stop if you feel pinching or sharp pain.

Glute bridge.what: Lie on your back and lift your hips. Builds glutes and is gentle on the back and pelvic floor.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width
Breathe out, gently lift your pelvic floor and draw your belly in
Press through your heels and lift your hips to a straight line
Pause 2 seconds, lower slowly. Add a dumbbell on your hips when 15 feel easy

Dead bug.what: Lie on your back and slowly lower opposite arm and leg. Rebuilds deep core strength after pregnancy.
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90° over your hips
Press your lower back gently into the floor
Breathe out and slowly lower one leg (and the opposite arm only if your shoulder allows)
Return and switch sides. If your belly domes or your back arches, make the movement smaller

Pallof press.what: Press a cable or band straight out from your chest and resist the twist. Trains the core to stay steady.
steps: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, hold the handle at your chest
Feet hip-width, soft knees, ribs down
Breathe out and press straight out, don't let it pull you round
Hold 2 seconds, bring it back. Do all reps, then face the other way

Dumbbell step-up.what: Step up onto a low box holding light dumbbells. Builds legs and balance.
steps: Use a low box or step, knee height or lower
Hold light dumbbells at your sides, shoulders relaxed
Place your whole foot on the box and push through that heel to stand up
Step down slowly. Do all reps on one leg, then switch

Close-grip lat pulldown (light).what: Pull a close-grip bar down to your chest. Rebuilds back strength and overhead range after a shoulder operation.
steps: Use a close or neutral grip and start light
Sit tall, pull to your upper chest, shoulders down and back
Let the bar rise slowly, only as high as is pain-free
Add weight only when all reps feel smooth
Close-grip lat pulldown (light).caution: Shoulder: build up gradually and keep it pain-free. Stop if you feel pinching or sharp pain.

Band external rotation.what: Rotate your forearm outward against a light band with your elbow at your side. Classic shoulder rehab for the rotator cuff.
steps: Tie a light band at elbow height, stand side-on
Elbow bent 90° and tucked against your side (a rolled towel helps)
Rotate your hand outward slowly, keeping the elbow still
Return slowly. Use the exact variation and band your physio gave you, if any
Band external rotation.caution: Shoulder: build up gradually and keep it pain-free. Stop if you feel pinching or sharp pain.

Side plank from knees.what: Hold a side plank with knees bent. Strengthens the side of the core without straining the midline.
steps: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, knees bent behind you
Lift your hips so your body is straight from knees to head
Breathe normally and hold for the time given
Switch sides. If your shoulder complains, skip it and do a second set of bird dogs
Side plank from knees.caution: Shoulder: build up gradually and keep it pain-free. Stop if you feel pinching or sharp pain.

Bird dog.what: On hands and knees, reach one leg back (and the opposite arm if comfortable). Trains core and back control safely.
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Breathe out and gently brace your belly
Slide one leg back to straight; reach the opposite arm forward only if your shoulder allows
Pause 2 seconds without your hips rocking, return and switch

Farmer's carry.what: Walk while holding dumbbells at your sides. Builds grip, core and posture, the strength you use carrying kids and shopping.
steps: Pick up two dumbbells you can hold for 30 seconds
Stand tall, shoulders down and back, ribs down
Walk slowly for the distance given
Put them down with a flat back. Use a lighter weight on the operated side if needed
Farmer's carry.caution: Shoulder: build up gradually and keep it pain-free. Stop if you feel pinching or sharp pain.

Incline dumbbell press (light).what: Press light dumbbells up on a bench tilted to about 30°, palms facing each other. Builds chest and shoulder strength in a shoulder-friendly position.
steps: Set the bench to a low incline and lie back
Hold light dumbbells at chest level, palms facing each other
Press up until your arms are straight, without locking hard
Lower slowly, only as deep as your shoulders are comfortable
